sn48.20:1.1: Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || la-pe || paññindriyām || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni || || Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānam bhavitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī ti || || Mudutaravaggo dutiyo
sn48.20:2.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Paṭilābho ca tayo Saṅkhittā || || Vitthārā apare tayo || Paṭipanno cupasamo || Āsavānaṃ
